latest.notes: Security: fixes a timer wrap that skipped the fingerprint check for 10 seconds every 71.6 minutes, and raises the anti-rollback version so earlier firmware can no longer be installed afterwards. Key generation now uses a hardware-seeded random generator. Fixes pairing on host slot 2 overwriting host 1; pairings are now stored per slot so dual-boot computers no longer collide. Removing the last authentication fingerprint while a switch fingerprint remains is now refused, and devices already in that state can recover. Adds a low-battery mode and halves deep-sleep current. The 32 kHz crystal load is now set explicitly so the connection stays stable during pairing and updates. Advertising runs for 60 seconds and then stops until a touch or button press. Unpairing the only host performs a factory reset.
